product_overview: Perch is an Airbnb-style marketplace connecting professionals who need meeting spaces with cafes that list available tables and rooms. Workers search, book, and pay for spaces while cafe owners manage listings, availability, and payouts via Razorpay.
core_goals: Enable workers to discover and book cafe meeting spaces with a smooth search, booking, and payment flow.
Provide cafe owners tools to list spaces, manage availability, and view earnings/payouts.
Securely process payments using Razorpay with escrow-like split settlements and robust webhook handling.
Comply with data protection requirements (DPDP), encrypt meeting content at rest, and preserve role-based data privacy.
Ship a mobile-first, accessible, and performant experience using Next.js, Neon Postgres, Clerk, and Uploadthing.

features.name: Authentication (Clerk)
features.description: User sign-up and sign-in using Clerk (Google OAuth, email/password, OTP); role selection at signup and server-side session verification for protected routes.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/sign-in (Clerk OAuth exchange) with provider token -> 200 with session token -> GET /api/users/me with session token -> 200 with user profile including role

POST /api/auth/sign-up (Clerk) with email,password and selected role=cafe_owner -> 201 with user id -> POST /api/webhooks/clerk simulated user.created event -> 200 and user synced to local users table
POST /api/auth/sign-in (Clerk) with invalid credentials -> 401 unauthorized -> No session token returned
GET /worker/dashboard with no session cookie -> 401 redirect to /sign-in -> Client re-authenticates

features.name: Landing Page / Public Content
features.description: Public homepage that surfaces animated hero, featured spaces, and CTAs; reads featured data from APIs for rendering and caching.
user_flows: GET /api/spaces?featured=true&limit=6 -> 200 with featured space list -> GET /api/cafes?ids=<space.owner_ids> -> 200 with cafe profiles to render trust bar and cards
GET /api/spaces?featured=true&limit=6 -> 500 server error -> GET /api/spaces?featured=true&use_cache=true -> 200 with cached featured list (fallback to cached content)

features.name: Space Search & Discovery
features.description: Search and filter spaces by location, date, capacity, amenities, noise level, and price; sort by distance, price, or rating. Uses PostGIS geospatial queries server-side.
user_flows: GET /api/search?lat=12.9716&lng=77.5946&date=2026-04-01&capacity=4&amenities=wifi,projector -> 200 with matching space ids and scores -> GET /api/spaces?id=<space_id> -> 200 with full space details -> GET /api/spaces/availability?space_id=<space_id>&date=2026-04-01 -> 200 with available time slots
GET /api/search?lat=12.9716&lng=77.5946&date=invalid-date -> 400 validation error with message 'invalid date' -> Client shows validation error and prompts correction

features.name: Booking Flow (Booking creation + Checkout)
features.description: Create bookings with meeting metadata, validate capacity and availability, invite attendees, and initiate Razorpay checkout for payment.
user_flows: POST /api/bookings with {space_id,date,start_time,duration,attendees_count,meeting_title,agenda_encrypted} -> 201 with booking_id and razorpay_order {order_id,amount} -> Client opens Razorpay Checkout with order_id -> Razorpay returns success and payment_id to client
POST /api/bookings with attendees_count greater_than_space_capacity -> 422 capacity validation error -> 422 returned and booking not created

features.name: Payments & Settlement (Razorpay)
features.description: Razorpay Standard Checkout for worker charges and Razorpay Route for split payments (platform fee + cafe payout). Webhook confirms captured payments and triggers settlement actions.
user_flows: POST /api/bookings with booking details -> 201 with razorpay_order.order_id -> Client launches Razorpay Checkout and completes payment -> POST /api/webhooks/razorpay with event 'payment.captured' (signed) -> 200 and system marks booking payment_status='captured' and creates payout instructions

POST /api/bookings to create order then client fails payment in Razorpay -> POST /api/webhooks/razorpay with event 'payment.failed' -> 200 and system sets booking.payment_status='failed', notifies worker and keeps booking pending or cancels per policy

features.name: Razorpay Webhook Handling (server-side)
features.description: Securely receive and verify Razorpay webhooks to update booking/payment state and initiate payouts via Razorpay Route. Signature verification required.
user_flows: POST /api/webhooks/razorpay with signed payload (payment.captured, order_id, payment_id) -> 200 -> GET /api/bookings?order_id=<order_id> -> 200 with booking -> POST /api/payments with {booking_id,payment_id,amount,split_details} -> 201 to enqueue payout
POST /api/webhooks/razorpay with invalid or missing signature -> 401 signature verification failed -> No booking update or payout initiated

features.name: Clerk Webhook (user sync)
features.description: Receive Clerk webhooks to keep the local users table in sync when users sign up or change metadata; used to persist role selection and profile data.
user_flows: POST /api/webhooks/clerk with event 'user.created' and valid Clerk signature -> 200 -> Server upserts user into users table with chosen role and contact info
POST /api/webhooks/clerk with malformed payload or invalid signature -> 401 -> Event ignored and no DB changes

features.name: File Uploads (Uploadthing + Cloudinary)
features.description: Upload cafe documents (GST, FSSAI) and space images using Uploadthing for documents and Cloudinary for images. Backend issues upload URLs and stores references.
user_flows: POST /api/uploadthing with {file_name,file_type,usage=cafe_document} -> 200 with upload_url and file_id -> Client uploads file to Uploadthing using upload_url -> 201 upload confirmed -> POST /api/cafes with cafe profile and document file_id -> 201 cafe created with document reference
POST /api/uploadthing with file size > max_allowed -> 413 payload too large -> Client shows error and prevents submission

features.name: Reviews & Ratings
features.description: Workers can submit ratings and text reviews after a completed booking; cafe owners can respond. Reviews are restricted to completed bookings.
user_flows: POST /api/reviews with {booking_id,rating,metrics:{wifi,noise,quality},text} after booking status='completed' -> 201 review created -> GET /api/spaces?id=<space_id> -> 200 with updated aggregated ratings
POST /api/reviews with {booking_id,...} for booking status != 'completed' -> 403 forbidden with message 'Review allowed only after completion' -> Review not created

features.name: Cafe Management (Cafe owners)
features.description: Cafe owners create profiles, submit verification documents, add and manage spaces (photos, amenities, pricing, availability), and view earnings and payout status.
user_flows: POST /api/uploadthing with image metadata -> 200 with upload_url -> Client uploads space photo and receives file_id -> POST /api/spaces with {cafe_id,name,capacity,price_per_hour,amenities,photos:[file_id],availability_rules} -> 201 space created
POST /api/cafes with missing required fields (e.g. gst_number) -> 400 validation error -> Creation rejected and client shows field-level errors
POST /api/cafes with documents references -> 201 -> POST /api/cafes/:id/verification-request -> 202 verification_status set to 'pending' (admin review queued)

code_summary.description: Airbnb-style marketplace where cafes list their spaces and professionals book them for business meetings. Full payment flow via Razorpay with escrow-like settlements.

tech_stack.framework: Next.js 16.2.0 (App Router, React Server Components, TypeScript)
tech_stack.auth: Clerk v7.0.6 (Google OAuth, Email/Password, OTP) + Svix webhooks
tech_stack.database: Neon PostgreSQL (serverless) + Drizzle ORM v0.45.1 + PostGIS
tech_stack.payments: Razorpay v2.9.6 (Standard Checkout + Route for split payments)
tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + Framer Motion + Radix UI + shadcn/ui + Aceternity UI
